bundle.shortDescription: The AI copilot that sees your screen
bundle.longDescription: Clickr AI is a free, open-source floating AI copilot for your Mac. Ask about anything on your screen, analyze files, and let Agent Mode do tasks for you. It runs on a free open model on your own computer.
